name: swept-channel
why: The sweep op against a closed form: a 10 mm square bar around one 90-degree bend of 20 mm is 100*60 of straight run plus Pappus's 100*20*pi/2 for the bend, 9141.59 mm3. The B-rep reads 0.005% under it, which is the tessellation under-reading the bend's cylinder walls, the same effect bent-tube records; the surfaces themselves are exact, 2 cylinders and the rest planes, no splines. The implicit half is the contract: refuse by name, point at the B-rep, never approximate.
